description: Use this when the user wants a single workout they can follow and track in Phorme: one written in this conversation, pasted from notes, or built to fit their time and equipment. It checks the workout, matches each exercise to the Phorme movement library with a demo link, flags anything that needs equipment the user did not list or runs past their time, and stores a private preview for 24 hours. It does not save training to any account. Do not use it for multiweek programs, nutrition plans, or pain and injury questions.

available_equipment.description: Equipment the user said they have, for example ["dumbbells", "bench"] or ["none"]. Leave out when the user did not say.

origin.description: Use "sport_week" when the workout is a session returned by preview_sport_week. Otherwise leave out.

time_limit_minutes.description: Minutes the user said they have. Leave out when the user did not say.

workout.description: The workout to preview, taken from this conversation.

estimated_duration_minutes.description: Expected length of the workout in minutes.

exercises.description: Exercises in the order they are performed. At most 300 sets in total.

duration.description: Work time in seconds for a timed exercise.

load.description: Target load, for example "80%", "135 lb", "60 kg", "bodyweight" or "RPE 8".

name.description: Exercise name as written in the conversation, for example "Back squat".

notes.description: Short coaching note for this exercise.

reps.description: Reps per set as short text, for example "8", "8-10", "AMRAP" or "40 sec".

rest.description: Rest between sets, for example "90 sec" or "2 min".

notes.description: Short note for the whole workout.

title.description: Workout name, for example "Lower body strength".

name: preview_workout_import

exercises.description: Each exercise with its Phorme library match and demo link.

equipment_ok.description: Whether that fits the equipment the user listed. Null when no equipment was given or the library does not say.

library_name.description: The Phorme movement it matched, or null when nothing matched.

expires_at.description: When the preview can no longer be saved, as an ISO 8601 time.

preview_id.description: Identifies this preview when it is saved.

requires_confirmation.description: Always true: saving needs the user's confirmation.

warnings.description: Items the user should review before saving.

title: Preview workout in Phorme
